kitchens_location_range.name: kitchens_location_range
kitchens_location_range.value: "kitchens"."location_lat" is null or ("kitchens"."location_lat" between 6 and 37 and "kitchens"."location_lng" between 68 and 98)

orders_agent_present.name: orders_agent_present
orders_agent_present.value: "orders"."status" not in ('picked_up', 'delivered') or "orders"."agent_id" is not null

messages_one_recipient.name: messages_one_recipient
messages_one_recipient.value:
("messages"."recipient" = 'customer' and "messages"."customer_id" is not null and "messages"."kitchen_id" is null and "messages"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("messages"."recipient" = 'kitchen' and "messages"."kitchen_id" is not null and "messages"."customer_id" is null and "messages"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("messages"."recipient" = 'agent' and "messages"."agent_id" is not null and "messages"."customer_id" is null and "messages"."kitchen_id" is null)
